data.body:
[P2] Check rejections first discovered during retirement

A service retry first discovered during retirement and proven `UNDISPATCHED` has no wrapper entry, so it never enters `context.attempts` or the coordinator's late-request merge. With no frozen cutoff obligations, this return skips it; `_evaluate_capture()` also excludes its new resource when projecting retirement onto the frozen inventory. The physical audit accepts the rejection, allowing the case to pass despite the contract requiring undispatched invocations to remain incomplete. Check independent retirement resources for these rejections during behavior adjudication, preserving physical target reuse, and add coverage for retirement-only discovery.
